definitions.explanation: An optical disc used to store digital audio or data.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧CD⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十|じゅっ}⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: This CD has ten songs on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧CD⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聴|き}く→聴く：30010_kiku⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦ストリーミング→ストリーミング：06031_sutoriimingu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主流|しゅりゅう}→主流：11407_shuryuu⟧になった。
examples.english: Recently, fewer people listen to CDs, and streaming has become mainstream.

notes:
CD (Compact Disc) was the dominant music format in Japan from the 1980s through the 2000s. Japan has one of the world's largest CD markets, and physical CD sales remain significant compared to other countries.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- CDプレーヤー: CD player
- CD⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧: CD shop
- ⟦シングル→シングル：10949_shinguru⟧CD: single CD
- ⟦アルバム→アルバム：03831_arubamu⟧CD: album CD
- CD-R: recordable CD
- CD-ROM: CD-ROM (data disc)

CD is written in the English alphabet in Japanese text.
